stem.text: A sphere falls from rest through the air. The graph shows the variation with time of the sphere's velocity.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity on the vertical axis against time on the horizontal axis, with a curve from the origin and a point labelled P on the curve.

stem.text: Which diagram shows the forces acting on the sphere when it is at the velocity corresponding to point P on the graph?

A.alt: Diagram of a sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance and a downward arrow labelled weight.

B.alt: Diagram of a sphere with a downward arrow labelled weight.

C.alt: Diagram of a sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance and a downward arrow labelled weight.

D.alt: Diagram of a sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance and a downward arrow labelled weight.
